intent: A full calendar of events by month, week, day, or list. Browse dates, filter calendars, add / edit / delete events.
useWhen: A schedule people browse by date: shifts, PTO, holidays, billing runs, meetings
Adding and editing dated events in place
Several calendars layered on one view, each in its own tone
doNotUseWhen: Picking one date or a range in a form — use DatePicker
A timeline of one record — use Table or Timeline

label.note: Names the calendar region for screen readers.

events.itemShape: { id: string; title: string; start: string; end?: string; allDay?: boolean; calendar?: string; tone?: CalendarTone; note?: string }
events.note: Controlled events. start and end are local ISO: 2024-10-09 all-day, 2024-10-09T08:30 timed. An all-day end is the last day, inclusive. A timed event with no end lasts one hour. tone overrides the source calendar’s color.

defaultEvents.note: Starting events when the Calendar keeps changes itself.

onEventsChange.note: Called with the full new list after an event is created, edited, or deleted.

onEventClick.note: Called when an event is clicked, before the edit drawer opens (or instead of it when readOnly).

calendars.itemShape: { id: string; name: string; tone?: CalendarTone; hidden?: boolean }
calendars.note: Sources. Color events, fill the event-form Calendar field, list in the Calendars drawer. hidden starts one hidden. Without calendars there is no Calendars button.

view.note: Controlled view. Leave it out to let the switch change it.

views.note: Which views the switch offers, in order. Defaults to month, week, day, and list. With one view there is no switch.

date.note: Controlled focused date, YYYY-MM-DD. The view shows the month, week, or day around it.

defaultDate.note: The first focused date. Defaults to today.

weekStart.note: The first day of each week row and of Week and List.

startHour.note: Week and Day open scrolled to this hour (0–23). The whole day can still be scrolled.

readOnly.note: Hides New event and turns off creating, editing, and deleting. Events can still be clicked through onEventClick.

requirements: Visible title (month, week, or day) is a heading and aria-live polite when it changes

Month is role=grid; one day is in the tab order; arrows move a day or a week; Home and End go to the week’s ends; Page Up and Page Down change the month; Enter opens a new event (or Day view when readOnly)
Day accessible name is the full date and event count
Every event is a button named title + time + calendar. Color is never the only cue
Month event chips, +N more, and day numbers are at least 24px tall
Icon-only Previous and Next are kit Buttons with a kit Tooltip; aria-labels name the step (month, week, or day)
The event form and the Calendars list open in a kit Drawer, which traps focus
+N more and the day numbers open Day view

doNot: Do not invent EventCalendar, Scheduler, MonthGrid, or DateGrid as public components
Do not use DatePicker for this schedule — DatePicker is a form date field
Do not put a primary Button in the toolbar; the event form’s Save is the primary action
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps; pick a tone (brand, success, warning, danger, info, accent)
Do not use Calendar as a form control — use DatePicker
Do not ship a second month-grid Calendar in the catalog
snippet:
<Calendar
  label="Team calendar"
  calendars={calendars}
  events={events}
  onEventsChange={setEvents}
  defaultView="week"
/>
